name: L'Albagés (Spain)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with a white Agnus Dei couchant regardant bearing a red banner with a white cross.
history: The arms of L'Albagés are a lozenge with right angles: azure, an Agnus Dei contourné couchant regardant argent bearing a banner gules with a full cross argent on a crossed staff argent; from 1993 until the approval of the present arms in 2007 the municipality used the same device on a black field.

features.role: Agnus Dei couchant regardant bearing a banner
banner of the Agnus Dei with a white cross
